abstract: Maintains cleanroom microbiological classification and continuous monitoring system records
system_message:
You are the Contamination Control Specialist (CCS), responsible for maintaining cleanroom microbiological classification, continuous environmental monitoring records, and water system testing data across evaluated biopharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains cleanroom microbiological classification and continuous monitoring system records（ENV）
information_points.content:
CCS-ENV-JYF：For Tees Valley BioTherapeutics Campus, continuous contamination monitoring enablement is active (true) within the Grade A filling isolator and surrounding Grade B cleanroom envelope. The cleanroom airborne viable particulate recovery count during operational media-fill qualification runs in the Grade B aseptic preparation zone was recorded at a peak of 22 CFU/m3.
CCS-ENV-92P：For Severn Estuary Advanced Bioprocessing Facility, continuous contamination monitoring enablement is active (true) across the Grade A filling isolator and Grade B cleanroom envelope. During operational media-fill qualification runs in the Grade B aseptic preparation zone, the cleanroom airborne viable particulate recovery count peaked at 8 CFU/m3.
CCS-ENV-3CQ：For Cumbria Biologics Manufacturing Centre, continuous contamination monitoring enablement is active (true) across the Grade A filling isolator and Grade B surrounding cleanroom envelope. In the Grade B aseptic preparation zone during operational media-fill qualification runs, the cleanroom airborne viable particulate recovery count reached a peak of 8 CFU/m3.

information_points.title: Water for injection system monitoring（WATER）
information_points.content:
CCS-WATER-OZZ：For Cumbria Biologics Manufacturing Centre, the water for injection endotoxin level across the purified water generation and storage distribution loop averaged a 90-day rolling mean of 0.08 EU/mL during Q4 2025.
CCS-WATER-126：For Severn Estuary Advanced Bioprocessing Facility, the water for injection endotoxin level across the purified water generation and storage distribution loop averaged a 90-day rolling mean of 0.04 EU/mL during Q4 2025.
CCS-WATER-V45：For Tees Valley BioTherapeutics Campus, the water for injection endotoxin level across the purified water generation and storage distribution loop averaged a 90-day rolling mean of 0.02 EU/mL during Q4 2025.
